_description: Images BUILT INTO the bg-n8n-mcp container. Every entry here force-dispatches a release when its digest moves (see check-base-images.yml), so only images whose contents actually ship inside our artifact belong in this file. Deliberately absent: redis:8-alpine and ghcr.io/czlonkowski/n8n-mcp. Both are docker-compose sidecars that appear nowhere in the Dockerfile — their digests moving would produce content-free version bumps of OUR image. They are watched instead by Dependabot's docker-compose ecosystem, which opens a PR to review rather than cutting a release. That matters especially for n8n-mcp: it is a third-party image whose updates should be read before they ship.
